step1_analysis.description: A pseudo-differential cascode amplifier stage. In the context of a 5-GHz transceiver, this topology is typically used as an LNA core, a mixer transconductor, or an IF amplifier to provide high bandwidth and reverse isolation.

paper_reference.title: A 5-GHz CMOS Transceiver for IEEE 802.11a Wireless LAN Systems

voltage_gain.description: Differential voltage gain of the amplifier

sky130_expected.calculation: gm = 2*Id/Vov. For W/L=5/0.5 at Vgs=0.9V, Id ~ 310uA and gm ~ 1.3mS. With a 1kOhm testbench load, Av = gm*RL = 1.3 V/V = 2.3 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Gain depends heavily on the load resistor chosen for the testbench. With a 1k load, the gain is relatively low due to the small W/L ratio of the input pair.

sky130_expected.calculation: BW = 1 / (2*pi*RL*Cout). Cout is dominated by the drain parasitics of the cascode devices (XM3/XM4), approx 10-20fF. BW ~ 1 / (2*pi*1k*20fF) = 8 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The small device sizes and 1k resistive load result in a very high bandwidth, making it suitable for the 5-GHz RF/IF applications mentioned in the paper.

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumption of the stage

sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on the DC bias of 0.9V and W/L=5/0.5 for the input pair.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench for the differential cascode amplifier measuring DC power, AC differential gain, 3-dB bandwidth, and transient peak-to-peak output.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Differential Cascode Amplifier Testbench

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 N3 VIN_PLUS N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM3 VOUT_PLUS VDD N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 VOUT_MINUS VDD N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM2 N4 VIN_MINUS N5 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}

* Power Supply
VVDD VDD 0 1.8

* Input Signals (DC=0.9V, AC=2V differential, Tran=200mVpp differential at 1MHz)
VVIN_PLUS VIN_PLUS 0 DC 0.9 AC 1 SIN(0.9 0.1 1MEG 0 0)
VVIN_MINUS VIN_MINUS 0 DC 0.9 AC -1 SIN(0.9 0.1 1MEG 180 0)

* Grounding the sources of the input pair (Pseudo-differential configuration)
VN2 N2 0 0
VN5 N5 0 0

* Load resistors
RL1 VDD VOUT_PLUS 1k
RL2 VDD VOUT_MINUS 1k

* Ideal balun/VCVS to extract differential output
Ediff VOUT_DIFF 0 VOUT_PLUS VOUT_MINUS 1.0

.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.control
* 1. DC Operating Point & Power
op
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print power

* 2. AC Analysis for Gain and Bandwidth
ac dec 100 1k 100G
* Input is 2V differential (1V - (-1V)), so subtract 20*log10(2) = 6.0206 dB
let gain_db = vdb(VOUT_DIFF) - 6.0206
meas ac max_gain MAX gain_db
let gain_3db = max_gain - 3
meas ac bw_3db when gain_db=gain_3db fall=1

* 3. Transient Analysis
tran 1n 5u
meas tran vout_diff_pp PP v(VOUT_DIFF)

quit
.endc
.end
